open_questions: Scr_ReleaseAnyValue is declared void in the shared prototypes and symbols, but FUN_08084bb2 returns a value consumed by Player_SetConfigIndex, Player_GiveWeapon and others. Chunk 102 declares fn_08084bb2 returning uint32; the merge lane should decide the real signature and rename the placeholder.

Field conflicts with chunk 051: gentity +0x158 is the client pointer here (not clientData void*), weaponDef name is at +0 with the display name at +4 (chunk 051 names only +0), and the client weapon bitset is 4 words (0x544..0x553) with slot bytes at 0x555/0x556, not the 8-word bitset named in chunk 040.
client_s is a partial layout defined in this chunk; chunk 051 defines client_t (size 0x28a4) with a different field set. The merge lane must reconcile the two definitions before linking.
Sys_Main (0x080d4f7c) is probably the ELF main body (argc/argv, never returns); confirm the entry-point wiring from the _start/__libc_start_main path.

DObj_PropagatePartBits (0x080b9b80), XModelParts_CollectPartInfo (0x080ba7f2) and XAnim_NotifyNodeChildren (0x080c1e76) are translated structurally from the goto-form pseudocode; their semantic names are unknown and should be confirmed against the DObj/XAnim owners.
